body: From the DM-179 review (orchestrator, this run): (1) the `this_machine` provenance label on human feedback is still a label, not a signature (a copied real desktop session id passes, spaceSignals.ts:421,805): never present it as verified in the tab — show recorded-by as provenance text. (2) Score reader (src/renderer/src/scorecard/scoreReads.ts) follow-ups to fix as you build on it: two rare interleavings start two concurrent reads of one selection (:203-204: clear `this.queued` only if it is still this callback's promise; direct-start branch must respect an existing queue); a loader that throws synchronously leaves the reader stuck in `loading` (:223-224: wrap as `Promise.resolve().then(selection.load)`).
